purpose: standard flare-forecast verification apparatus (Leka et al. 2019 toolkit): TSS, HSS, Brier skill score, reliability, persistence and climatology baselines — v4.1 (Dossier R-FS9-R1 items A1-A6)

definitions.persistence_prev_window: same active region, immediately preceding window in ts_start_min order (hourly within-AR cadence; the 12-min figure is the MVTS record cadence, a different quantity): the label-inertia floor
definitions.persistence_24h_lag: same active region, window nearest to t - 1440 min within +/-35 min: the Leka-style 24-hour-lagged floor
definitions.zero_alert_semantics: stored precision = recall = 0 encodes a zero-alert forecast: fp = 0 and TSS = HSS = 0.0
